title: Tide and Cinder
shortDescription: Bless your blades, melt the slimes, slay the Cinder Tyrant.
fullDescription: Tide and Cinder is a single-player elemental action quest built on the Heretek engine. Take the Dungeon Keeper's Hydro blessing, carve through waves of Pyro slimes with animation-driven melee, trigger Vaporize reactions, swap between two heroes mid-fight, and bring down the Cinder Tyrant — telegraphed slam and all. One hand-authored dungeon, a three-biome floor, a day/night rig, a five-stage quest chain, and a second commission for the road. No accounts, no network, no ads: just you, two blades, and sixty seconds of bad decisions.
notes: Screenshots are unedited renderer captures from a real playthrough (menu, keeper briefing, wave combat, victory). Icon and feature graphic are original PIL compositions for this title.
